verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a 'Seer Agent' that lets users 'ask any question about your application' and finds the right telemetry to answer it, plus an MCP server that lets AI assistants search errors and analyze performance in natural language — both directly support NL-to-telemetry queries. However, evidence doesn't show it returning a formal chart/query object (vs. an answer/summary) or independent hands-on confirmation of accuracy. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent verification of the NL query-to-chart output, detail on chart generation fidelity, and confirmation this works beyond the Seer/MCP surface.
